title: Owl wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,10 40,34 60,34' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 44,22 56,22' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 47,16 53,16' fill='#4fd2ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='3.5' fill='#ffe95c'/>
  <!-- Hat base band -->
  <rect x='39' y='31' width='22' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4fd2ff'/>
  <!-- Ears / tufts -->
  <polygon points='24,34 30,20 38,33' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <polygon points='76,34 70,20 62,33' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='32' fill='#b07a3f'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#e8c98f'/>
  <!-- Wing left -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='64' rx='8' ry='17' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- Wing right -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='64' rx='8' ry='17' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- Face disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#e8c98f'/>
  <!-- Eye patches -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='44' r='12' fill='#f7f0dc'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='12' fill='#f7f0dc'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='44' r='6' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='6' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='44' r='3' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='3' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points='50,50 45,59 55,59' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='92' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
</svg>
